L190: ## Welcome to the College of Health
L191: 
L192: We are an industry-connected hub of health education and research, delivering real-world impact in Australia and around the world.
L193: 
L194: For aspiring health professionals and leaders, we teach a wide range of contemporary undergraduate and postgraduate degrees. You’ll graduate workforce ready to address critical and emerging health issues, improve the quality of patient care and shape the wellbeing of individuals and communities.
L195: By collaborating with leading industry partners and research organisations, our research uses community and global insights to study, diagnose, treat, and prevent key health challenges of our time.
L196: Our dedicated campus facilities, laboratories, simulated environments and community clinics are applied spaces for practical learning and research transformation. No matter how you engage with us, you’ll be guided by and connected with our vibrant community of leading academics, researchers, clinicians and industry partners.
L197: 
L198: We work in and alongside community to drive real outcomes, be at the forefront of innovation and work to improve the health and wellbeing for generations to come.
L199: ### Hands on degrees
L200: 
L201: Our broad range of health degrees offer a seamless transition from study to career. Engage in student-centred learning in world-class facilities, led by industry-leading educators.
L202: 
L203: 【6†Study with us】
L204: 
L205: ### Industry and community aligned research and capabilities
L206: 
L207: We transform industry and community challenges into practical realities. Our research generates new insights, innovates new treatments and technologies, and drives policy.
L208: 
L209: 【59†Discover our research】
L210: ## Discover the college
L211: 
L212: Access to good healthcare impacts everyone – it helps individuals access care and empowers experts to shape policy that supports entire populations. As Adelaide University’s interconnected home of health, discover how we can help you embark on your future career or further build your existing capabilities, drive revolutionary health research, or get involved as an industry partner or through community engagement.
L213:   1. Our study areas Our study areas
L214:   2. Our research Our research
L215:   3. Partner with us Partner with us
L216:   4. Our people Our people
L217:   5. Our facilities Our facilities
L218: 
L219: Your path to a rewarding career in healthcare begins with the College of Health.
L220: ### Our Schools
L221: 
L222: We are home to six dedicated schools:
L223: 
L224: #### Allied Health and Human Performance
L225: 
L226: Delivering intersectional care in Allied Health, Sport Science and Nutrition to maximise individual and community wellbeing.
L227: 
L228: 【106†Learn more】
L229: 
L230: #### Pharmacy and Biomedical Science
L231: 
L232: Enhancing clinical outcomes and driving biomedical innovation across medicines, technology and clinical trials.
L233: 
L234: 【107†Learn more】
L235: #### Medicine
L236: 
L237: Educating the next generation of future-thinking medical doctors to meet patient needs and enhance delivery of care.
L238: 
L239: 【108†Learn more】
L240: 
L241: #### Dentistry
L242: 
L243: Providing innovative preventative and restorative care to keep communities healthy, nourished and communicating.
L244: 
L245: 【109†Learn more】
L246: 
L247: #### Nursing and Midwifery
L248: 
L249: Supporting Australia’s largest health workforce to deliver care at critical times in people’s lives
L250: 
L251: 【110†Learn more】
L252: #### Public Health
L253: 
L254: Promoting local, national and international healthcare system assessment to continually improve healthy living, prolonging life, and preventing disease.
L255: 
L256: 【111†Learn more】
L257: ### Supported and practical learning in world-class facilities
L258: 
L259: Our degrees respond to industry and community needs and will set you up for success in your future career. Our campuses are home to dedicated laboratory and simulation spaces including anatomy, chemistry and biology labs, simulated hospital wards, commercial kitchens, research-aligned pharmacy labs, Mass Spectrometry & Proteomics facility,
L260:  clinical trial facilities, Histology services and more. We’re also home to the Adelaide Health Simulation – the most technologically advanced medical simulation facility in Australasia.
L261: 
L262: Practise your skills in these spaces under the supervision of expert clinical staff including clinicians, researchers and academics nationally and internationally renowned in their fields.
L263: ### Real-world placements
L264: 
L265: Many of our health degrees include professional, clinical and field placements across metropolitan, regional and rural environments. You’ll get valuable experience within a breadth of diverse workplace environments while still studying, ensuring you graduate as an informed health practitioner.
L266: As part of the College of Health, you’ll also get to engage with research projects, connect with experts within your field, collaborate with other health students from other disciplines, and benefit from global opportunities such as study exchanges.
L267: 
L268: We strive to improve healthcare, equity, education and wellbeing for all.
L269: ### Our scope
L270: 
L271: Our exciting, diverse and impactful health research facilitates improvements in medicine, healthcare and the overall wellbeing of our society. Our research activity is grounded in real-world solutions and applications and is closely connected with our global reaching partners.
L272: We aim to create a healthier society with better health outcomes, experience and quality-of-life for all. Our endeavours support South Australia’s future biomedical and health economy, drive more equitable and thorough access to academic-led health research, and recognise Adelaide University as a driving force for health innovation.
L273: ### Our pillars of research focus include
L274: 
L275: #### Discovery and personalised health
L276: 
L277: Applying knowledge from discovery research in molecular, genetic, epigenetic, data mining and other techniques to innovate personalised care for our future healthcare systems.
L278: 
L279: #### Lifelong health and wellbeing
L280: 
L281: Preventing, treating and improving health conditions across all stages of life.
L282: 
L283: #### Future health systems
L284: 
L285: Building the capacity and practice of Australia’s healthcare system.
L286: #### Thriving communities
L287: 
L288: Informing, influencing and improving policy and practice for health, wellbeing and equity.
L289: 
L290: #### Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander equity
L291: 
L292: Championing culturally safe and community-driven research that improves outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.
L293: ### Our research centres
L294: 
L295: We have a broad range of research institutes, centres and concentrations across our six schools.
L296: 
L297: We address issues spanning individual to society level, and tackle challenges ranging from Australia’s leading causes of ill health through to improving the health system itself. Our research focuses include cancer, heart health, improved nutrition and medicine usage, reproductive health, genetics and population health, and data driven analysis.
